segments.title: Quoting one price? You're leaving money on the table
segments.say: If you quote one price, the customer can only say yes or no. Offer three packages, and the question becomes: which one?

segments.title: One prompt, three packages

chat.user: I offer [service] to [type of customer]. Suggest 3 package names, what each includes, and questions I should ask before I set prices.
chat.ai: (Example answer) Starter: the essentials. Plus: adds setup and training. Complete: everything, with a 1-year check-up.

segments.say: Paste this prompt. A I suggests three package names, what goes in each one, and the questions to ask before you set a price. You decide the numbers.

segments.title: Results vary. The prompt is free
bullets: Help us reach 100 subscribers by Dec 31
segments.say: Results vary, and you still have to do great work. The prompt is in the description. Subscribe for the next A I money move.
